walks.name: Hops 0 from one root
walks.cypher: MATCH (a:Term {id: 1}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: Hops 1 from one root
walks.cypher: MATCH (t:Term {id: 1})-[:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO*0..1]-(a:Term) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: Hops 2 from one root
walks.cypher: MATCH (t:Term {id: 1})-[:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO*0..2]-(a:Term) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: Hops 3 from one root
walks.cypher: MATCH (t:Term {id: 1})-[:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO*0..3]-(a:Term) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: All hops from one root: to the end of its connected part
walks.cypher: MATCH (t:Term {id: 1})-[:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO*0..4]-(a:Term) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: Hops 0 from several roots
walks.cypher: MATCH (a:Term) WHERE a.id IN [1, 6] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: Hops 2 from several roots
walks.cypher: MATCH (t:Term)-[:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO*0..2]-(a:Term) WHERE t.id IN [1, 6] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: All hops from several roots
walks.cypher: MATCH (t:Term)-[:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO*0..4]-(a:Term) WHERE t.id IN [1, 8] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: Hops 2 over one link type
walks.cypher: MATCH (t:Term {id: 1})-[:KIND_OF*0..2]-(a:Term) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF]->(b:Term) RETURN DISTINCT a, r, b

walks.name: No link type kept: the roots alone
walks.cypher: MATCH (a:Term) WHERE a.id IN [1, 6] RETURN a

walks.name: No root: no term
walks.cypher: MATCH (a:Term) WHERE a.id IN [] RETURN a

walks.name: A focus: the terms drawn and the links between them
walks.cypher: MATCH (a:Term) WHERE a.id IN [1, 2, 3] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:KIND_OF|RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) WHERE b.id IN [1, 2, 3] RETURN a, r, b

walks.name: A focus over one link type
walks.cypher: MATCH (a:Term) WHERE a.id IN [1, 2, 3] OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:RELATED_TO]->(b:Term) WHERE b.id IN [1, 2, 3] RETURN a, r, b
